event_date_basis: Astral's own post carries frontmatter "date":"2026-03-19" and renders "March 19, 2026" above the headline (https://astral.sh/blog/openai). OpenAI's official news feed carries the matching item with pubDate "Thu, 19 Mar 2026 00:00:00 GMT" (https://openai.com/news/rss.xml). Announcement date and publication date are therefore the same day, 2026-03-19. The EFFECTIVE date is different and unknown: Astral writes "after the deal closes", i.e. the transaction was not closed on the announcement date, and no first-party page reachable from this container states a closing date or says the deal has since closed. OpenAI's own sitemap shows the announcement page with <lastmod>2026-08-31T19:59:25.765Z</lastmod>, which is a page-revision timestamp, not a deal date.
sourcing_notes: Astral's own announcement is fully readable and is a first-party source for its own acquisition, so the article can be written to spec. Reached (HTTP 200, body checked): https://astral.sh/blog/openai (52,443 bytes, full article text plus MDX frontmatter with author/date/category); https://astral.sh/blog/rss.xml (39 items, newest 2026-09-04 - live feed); https://openai.com/news/rss.xml (1,194 items, newest 2026-09-16 - live feed); https://openai.com/sitemap.xml and https://openai.com/sitemap.xml/company/ (261 URLs, includes the Astral announcement entry with lastmod and ~60 hreflang alternates); https://docs.astral.sh/uv/, /ruff/, /ty/; https://pypi.org/project/uv/ and the pypi JSON API for uv, ruff, ty; https://astral.sh/pyx; https://docs.pyx.dev/; https://astral.sh/blog/python-packaging-council, /ruff-v0.16.0, /uv-audit, /open-source-security-at-astral, /announcing-astral-the-company-behind-ruff; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astral-sh/{uv,ruff,ty}/main/LICENSE* and uv CHANGELOG.md; https://developers.openai.com/codex/. BLOCKED (HTTP 403, verified today with curl -A Mokaair-editorial AND with WebFetch): https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-astral and the trailing-slash form, every locale variant tested (ja-JP, zh-Hant), https://openai.com/news/, https://openai.com/index/, https://chatgpt.com/codex, https://help.openai.com/en/, https://api.github.com and https://github.com (github.com is 403 through this proxy; raw.githubusercontent.com is 200). The GitHub MCP tool is scoped to x812033727/travel_scanner only and refused astral-sh repos. SOURCE-SLOT NOTE FOR THE WRITER: BRIEF.md normally requires the article URL rather than the feed URL, but the OpenAI article page is 403 to every client, so https://openai.com/news/rss.xml is the ONLY reachable official OpenAI channel carrying OpenAI's own wording. This is a deliberate exception - do not let a checker 'fix' it by substituting the 403 article URL, which was never read. Alternate slot-4 sources if the writer prefers them over pypi.org/project/uv/: https://astral.sh/pyx (for the pyx signup fact) or https://astral.sh/blog/python-packaging-council (for Astral still operating as Astral on 2026-09-04).

Astral says OpenAI will continue supporting Astral's open source tools after the deal closes, and that Astral will keep building in the open. The sentence attributes this jointly to Astral's philosophy and to OpenAI's own announcement.

verified_facts.fact: Astral says that after joining the Codex team it will continue building its open source tools, explore ways they can work more seamlessly with Codex, and expand its reach. No timeline, version, feature or product name is attached to the Codex integration.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: After joining the Codex team, we'll continue building our open source tools, explore ways they can work more seamlessly with Codex, and expand our reach to think more broadly about the future of software development.

verified_facts.fact: The phrase "after the deal closes" establishes that, at the moment of the 2026-03-19 announcement, the transaction had been agreed but not completed.

verified_facts.fact: The three tools Astral names in the announcement are Ruff, uv and ty, and the announcement links each one to its repository under the astral-sh GitHub organisation (github.com/astral-sh/ruff, /uv, /ty). The post also links Codex to https://chatgpt.com/codex and links "OpenAI's own announcement" to https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-astral/ .

Astral claims its tools have grown from zero to hundreds of millions of downloads per month across Ruff, uv and ty, and that the Astral toolchain has become foundational to modern Python development. No per-tool number, no measurement period and no source for the figure are given; this is Astral's own characterisation and the site has not verified it.

verified_facts.fact: Charlie Marsh frames the move as a bet on AI-assisted software development: he writes that AI is rapidly changing how software is built, that the pace is accelerating, and that building at the frontier of AI and software is the highest-leverage thing Astral can do; he adds that it is increasingly clear to him that Codex is that frontier.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Today, AI is rapidly changing the way we build software, and the pace of that change is only accelerating. If our goal is to make programming more productive, then building at the frontier of AI and software feels like the highest-leverage thing we can do.

Ruff v0.16.0, published 2026-07-23 (author Brent Westbrook), enabled 413 rules by default, up from 59, and states that the number of rules in Ruff has grown from 708 to 968 since v0.1.0; 18 pycodestyle and pyflakes rules (E401, E402, E701, E702, E703, E711, E712, E713, E714, E721, E731, E741, E742, E743, F403, F405, F406, F722) were removed from the default set. This is an example of a breaking-ish change shipped under Astral after the announcement, not something attributable to OpenAI.

uv gained security features on 2026-06-08: "uv audit" scans dependencies for known vulnerabilities and adverse project statuses, described as a uv-native alternative to pip-audit and stated by Astral to be between 4x and 10x faster on typical projects; and an opt-in OSV-based malware lookup enabled by setting UV_MALWARE_CHECK=1. not_said: The purchase price, deal value, or any financial term is not stated anywhere in Astral's announcement, and OpenAI's one-line feed description gives no figure either. Write 「官方未公布金額」, never a number.

No closing date is stated. Astral says only "after the deal closes". Nothing on any first-party page reachable from this container says the deal has closed, so the article must not say it completed - the safe formulation is 「官方公告的是『已達成協議』，並未說明何時完成」.
No regulatory approval, antitrust review or closing condition is mentioned at all.

No headcount. Astral does not say how many people it employs, how many join OpenAI, or whether the entire team transfers. Marsh thanks "the Astral team" and says "I am so excited to keep building with you", which is not the same as a stated commitment that everyone moves.
No job title for Charlie Marsh at OpenAI. "Join OpenAI as part of the Codex team" is the only placement statement.

No licence commitment. Astral says OpenAI "will continue supporting our open source tools" and that Astral will "keep building in the open", but neither party states that uv, Ruff or ty will stay under MIT / Apache-2.0, states a duration for the commitment, or rules out future relicensing, a source-available model or paid tiers.
No statement about governance or ownership of the astral-sh GitHub organisation, the repositories, the trademarks, the Discord, or the Astral OSS Fund.

Nothing about pyx. The acquisition announcement does not mention Astral's commercial package registry at all. The pyx page separately says it is no longer accepting new signups, but gives no reason and no date - do NOT attribute that to the acquisition.
No roadmap for the promised Codex integration: no feature, no version, no date, no product name for "explore ways they can work more seamlessly with Codex".
No pricing. uv, Ruff and ty are free open source tools and no price, plan or paid tier is announced or changed.

No region or availability condition of any kind - nothing about Taiwan, the EU, or any market. This is a corporate transaction announcement, not a product launch, so do not write a 「台灣能不能用」 paragraph as if it were one.
No statement that uv, Ruff or ty will be bundled into, required by, or restricted to Codex.
No statement about ty reaching 1.0 or leaving preview; PyPI still shows 0.0.81.
No commitment about continued support for users who do not use OpenAI products.

OpenAI itself has said nothing publicly readable beyond the headline "OpenAI to acquire Astral" and the line "Accelerates Codex growth to power the next generation of Python developer tools". Everything else about OpenAI's intentions in this article comes from Astral's description of OpenAI's announcement, not from OpenAI's announcement itself.

editorial_brief: 讀者：台灣一般讀者中偵向「自己寫程式、或身邊有人寫程式」那一群，以及會委外、會拿別人寫的專案來維護的人。角度是「我依賴的工具被買走了，我該担心什麼」，不是企業併購或投資題材。本站 API 本身就用 uv 跟 ruff（apps/api/pyproject.toml 里面寫的是 ruff>=0.12,<1，uv.lock 鎖定 Python 3.13），這件事對這種專案是真的有影響，可以拿來寫成編輯自己設計的情境例子（要標明是編輯設計的例子）。五個小節建議：（1）發生了什麼——兩邊官方各自怎麼說，且一邊說 acquire、一邊說 join；（2）uv、Ruff、ty 分別是什麼工具，誰會碰到它們（末尾放 table）；（3）官方此刻實際承諾了什麼、沒承諾什麼（末尾放 diagram）；（4）六個月後的實際狀態：文件還寫 backed by Astral、PyPI 上 9/15 還在發版、授權檔還是 MIT／Apache-2.0；（5）使用者現在能做的檢查：鎖版本、看 CHANGELOG、確認授權檔、不要因為新聞就急著換工具。刻意不談：Codex 模型本身的能力（已有 ai-news-gpt-53-codex-20260205）、Agents API 計費（已有 ai-news-openai-agents-api-20260910）、OpenAI 的財務與上市話題、任何收購金額推測、以及「AI 會不會取代工程師」這種發想題。語氣平實：這是一則「已簽協議、未說完成、工具目前照常」的新聞，不要寫成危機也不要寫成利多。 topics 建議 ["ai","software","ai-news"]（跟 ai-news-gpt-53-codex-20260205 與 ai-news-openai-agents-api-20260910 一致），news_date "2026-03-19"，display_order 接在 148 之後。
overlaps_existing_article: 站上 38 篇 ai-news-* 裡面沒有任何一篇提到 Astral、uv 或 ruff（對 apps/api/app/guides/content/*.json 做過 grep -l -i ：astral 零筆、ruff 零筆），所以主題本身沒有重複。 需要劃清界線的是兩篇 Codex 相關稿：ai-news-gpt-53-codex-20260205「GPT-5.3-Codex 推出：AI 寫程式如何走向可交付的工作？」講的是模型能力與交付流程；ai-news-openai-agents-api-20260910「OpenAI Agents API 公開 beta」講的是計費與資料位置。 本篇只寫「收購這件事本身」與「開源 Python 工具鏈的去留」，不重述 Codex 的功能、模型代號或計費方式；要提到 Codex 時，只寫它是 OpenAI 的寫程式產品線，細節用站內連結導過去。 常騐稿 ai-coding-tools-overview-2026「AI 寫程式工具總覽」有提到 Codex，但那是工具選型指南，與本篇不衝突。 兩個 link 建議：第一個指 ai-news-2026-january-september-index（注意 ai.md 說這篇的 title 可能正在改，定稿前要重讀內容包拿正式 title），第二個指 ai-news-gpt-53-codex-20260205 或 ai-news-openai-agents-api-20260910。
must_not_write: 不可寫出任何收購金額、估值或股權比例——一手來源一個數字都沒给。
不可寫「收購已完成」「已正式並入」「Astral 現在是 OpenAI 的一部分」——官方只說「已達成協議」與「交易完成後」。
不可把 pyx 停止新註冊跟這樁收購接上因果，也不可幫它推一個時間點。
不可寫 uv、Ruff、ty 會閃閃閉源、會收費、會被並進 Codex、會要求 OpenAI 帳號——也不可反過來保證「永遠不會」。
不可把 OpenAI 公告頁的內文當成讀過：那一頁 403，可引用的 OpenAI 原文只有標題與那一句描述。
不可寫「本站實測」「我們裝了 0.12.15 後發現……」——本站沒有實測。
不可寫 Series A、Series B 的金額；只有 2023 年 400 萬美元種子輪有一手出處。
不可把「每月數億次下載」寫成事實，要寫「Astral 表示」。
不可寫任何地區可用性、台灣開放時程、方案限制——這一則根本沒有這些條件。
不可推測 Charlie Marsh 在 OpenAI 的職稱，也不可寫「全體團隊加入」——公告未說。
不可引用任何媒體、諧媒體、搜尋摘要或記憶中的數字；sources 只能放本紀錄列出且實際抓過的網址。
不可把 openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-astral 寫進 sources（沒讀到）；OpenAI 那一條用 openai.com/news/rss.xml。
不可出現簡體字；不可用列表、Markdown、emoji；不可下投資建議。
corrections_to_candidate_list: docs/news-2026-batch-4/candidates-tech-and-ai.md 第 130 行寫「Astral 是 uv／ruff 的開發商」，漏了第三個工具 ty（型別檢查器），Astral 的公告本文是三個一起點名的。
候選清單沒寫到：OpenAI 這篇公告頁（openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-astral）在本容器 403，實際可用的主要一手來源是 Astral 自己的 astral.sh/blog/openai（200）。
候選清單沒寫到：Astral 有官方 RSS https://astral.sh/blog/rss.xml（2026-09-16 實測 200、39 筆、最新一筆 2026-09-04），下一批找 Python 工具題目可直接用。
候選清單沒寫到：astral.sh 雖然是 Next.js，但對 curl 會回完整 HTML（含 MDX frontmatter 的 author／date／category），不屬於「前端渲染抓不到」那一類；但偶爾會 Connection reset by peer，加 --retry 3 --retry-all-errors 就好。
候選清單沒寫到：github.com 與 api.github.com 在本容器 403，但 raw.githubusercontent.com 回 200，可以拿 LICENSE、CHANGELOG.md 等檔案內容；pypi.org（頁面與 /pypi/<pkg>/json）也是 200。
候選清單沒寫到：openai.com/sitemap.xml 與 openai.com/sitemap.xml/company/ 都回 200，可以拿到官方正規網址與 lastmod，是 openai.com/index/* 403 時另一個可用的官方管道。
ai.md 的既有篇目表與本次 grep 一致：沒有任何一篇寫過 Astral／開源 Python 工具鏈，這個題目確實是缺口，不是重寫。
